parameters.query: SELECT config_key, value_numeric FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key LIKE 'SCANNER_%';
SELECT ticker, name, sektor, exchange FROM trading.stock_instruments WHERE aktiv = TRUE ORDER BY ticker;
SELECT ticker, aktueller_kurs, hoch_52w, tief_52w, data_quality_status FROM trading.technical_signals_history WHERE snapshot_date = CURRENT_DATE AND valid_to IS NULL;
SELECT ticker, strategy, direction, raw_score FROM trading.strategy_signals WHERE business_date = CURRENT_DATE AND valid_to IS NULL;
SELECT region, combined_regime FROM trading.market_regime WHERE business_date = CURRENT_DATE;
SELECT symbol, trading_date, close, volume FROM trading.stock_price_history WHERE valid_to IS NULL AND trading_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 70 ORDER BY symbol, trading_date;

SELECT ni.title AS titel, v.ticker_json AS betroffene_ticker_json, v.effect_level AS wirkung_staerke FROM trading.v_news_latest_assessment v JOIN trading.news_items ni ON ni.id = v.news_id WHERE v.relevance = TRUE AND v.effect_level = 'hoch' AND (ni.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date;
SELECT ticker, snapshot_date FROM trading.fundamentals_history WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 180 AND valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY ticker, snapshot_date;
